description: Dayjob offers an AI scheduling agent that integrates with existing ERP systems to continuously re-optimize short-haul truck routes in real time, handling new jobs, driver changes, and exceptions automatically.
funding_summary: Raised $1.6 million in August 2023 (Pre-Seed Round) and $500,000 in 2026 (Seed Round).
inflection_why_now: The increasing complexity of logistics operations and the need for real-time optimization present a significant opportunity for AI-driven solutions like Dayjob's.
devils_advocate_risks: Integration challenges with diverse ERP systems across various clients.
Dependence on the adoption rate of AI technologies within the logistics industry.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: As a leading enterprise software company, SAP could benefit from integrating Dayjob's AI scheduling solutions into its logistics and supply chain management offerings.
As a global logistics leader, DHL could leverage Dayjob's AI-driven scheduling to enhance route optimization and operational efficiency in its short-haul trucking operations.
